tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There is hereby authorized to be appropriated to carry out the provisions of this subchapter amounts as follows:

children.text: For each fiscal year after fiscal year 2001, such sums as may be necessary for such fiscal year.

tree.heading: Funding requests
tree.text: The President shall include in the budget submitted to Congress for each fiscal year under section 1105 of title 31 a request for amounts for the activities of the Board under this subchapter during such fiscal year.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly set out in a note under section 3161 of this title.
